app.tagline: Connect your Phantom board and your Twitch account for interactive games with your community

mono.vsStreamerDesc: You play on the board, registered viewers vote for the other side.
mono.teamsDesc: Registered viewers are randomly split into two teams, White and Black.

multi.desc: Two channels face off, yours plays White. Create the game: as soon as another channel joins, their chats have 2 minutes to sign up.
multi.loginRequired: Log in with Twitch to enter this game.
multi.followersScope: This game is for followers only: log in again to allow reading them.
multi.waitingHint: Send them this link: the 2 minutes of registration start once you are both here.

denied.invalid: This game link is invalid or has expired.

denied.playing: This game is already in progress.

multi.publicDesc: Listed in Browse: the first channel that clicks Join becomes your opponent.
multi.privateDesc: Visible in Browse (people can watch) but only the channel with the link can join. The link is never shown on screen.

multi.linkCopied: Link copied — don't show it on stream

tournamentFollow.title: Sync the Phantom
tournamentFollow.hint: Set this position directly, or reset the board and replay the game move by move. The Phantom then follows the moves played.

phantomModal.title: Phantom chessboard
phantomModal.intro: Phantom is a real wooden chessboard that moves its own pieces. Connected to the site, it plays out the moves voted by Twitch chat, or those of a Live Chess game or a followed tournament.
phantomModal.unlock1: Twitch games: the moves your chat votes for are played on the board.
phantomModal.unlock2: Live Chess: follow a Chess.com game live, move by move.
phantomModal.unlock3: Tournament: pick a game from an ongoing Chess.com tournament and watch it being played.
phantomModal.unlockHint: The Live Chess and Tournament tabs appear in the menu as soon as the Phantom is connected.
phantomModal.req1: Bluetooth turned on on your computer
phantomModal.req2: Chrome or Edge on desktop (Web Bluetooth: not Firefox or Safari)
phantomModal.unsupported: This browser doesn't support Bluetooth: open the site in Chrome or Edge.
phantomModal.credits: Learn more about the board and the team behind it:

records.desc: Top Puzzle Rush runs, channel battles and the most active viewers.
records.rushEmpty: No record for this mode yet. Start a run to put your channel on the board!
records.needRuns: One more run to see your curve
records.multiHint: Win 3 pts, draw 1 pt. Click a channel to see its matchups.
records.viewersEmpty: No viewer stats yet. They are recorded when the streamer is logged in with Twitch.
records.noVotes: No game votes for this channel.
records.noPuzzleVotes: No puzzle votes for this channel.
records.viewersHint: A viewer counts once per move, even with several votes. Stats are recorded when the streamer is logged in with Twitch.
records.sharpest: Best instinct: {name}, {n}% of their votes picked

tips.timer: On: each move has a voting time (10 to 120s), then the move is picked (wheel or majority). Off: no timer, the FIRST vote received is played immediately, and the other voting settings don't apply.
tips.turnDuration: How long chat has to vote on each move, from 10 to 120s. Mind the stream delay: 30s is a good start.
tips.wheelDuration: Length of the wheel animation that draws the move among the votes.
tips.votesPerViewer: How many different moves a viewer can suggest each turn. Stats only count them once per move.
tips.majority: On: the most voted move is played. Off: a wheel draw, each vote gives the move a chance.
tips.restrictions: Limit votes to followers and/or subscribers. The streamer, mods and VIPs can always vote. Followers requires allowing follower access when connecting Twitch.
tips.rushRating: Difficulty of the first puzzle. It goes up with each solved puzzle.
tips.rushPause: Wait between two puzzles, to breathe and look at the solution.
tips.rushMode: Time to find each move. Unlimited: the first valid move suggested by chat is played. Each time has its own leaderboard.
tips.problemThemes: Kinds of puzzles (mate in 2, fork, pin…). None selected: every theme.
tips.monoColor: The side you play on the board; registered viewers vote for the other one.
tips.voteTime: How long chat has to vote on each move.
tips.choice: Wheel: random draw weighted by votes. Majority: the most voted move is played.
tips.multiPublic: Public: listed in Browse, any channel can join. Private: anyone can watch, but only the channel with your link can join.

timerOff.warning: Timer off: the first vote received is played immediately.
timerOff.badgeHint: The first vote received is played

watch.notFound: This game is no longer running.
watch.ended: The game is over or the streamer left.
watch.waiting: Waiting for the game to start…
watch.bannerHint: You see the game just like the players, without playing or voting. They can see you're watching.
watch.rushToPlay: Chat is looking for the right move…

spectators.title: Spectators
spectators.anonymity: Visible: usernames and votes shown live. Hidden names: you see the voted moves, not who voted them. Secret vote: nothing during the turn (no podium, no arrow, no names), the result shows up at the draw or when the move is played. Votes are still written in the Twitch chat: hide it on your stream for a truly blind vote.
spectators.anonymityMulti: You choose for both channels: your opponent must follow this setting. Visible: usernames and votes live. Hidden names: the voted moves without usernames. Secret vote: nothing during the turn, the result shows up at the draw or when the move is played.
spectators.chroma: Replaces the page background with a solid colour you can key out in OBS with a "Chroma Key" filter. Pick a colour that isn't on the board or pieces (green by default).
spectators.loginHint: Log in with Twitch to appear with your username.

anonymity.title: Vote anonymity
anonymity.hintNames: Votes stay visible, without the viewers' usernames.
anonymity.hintSecret: No names or votes during the turn: the result shows up at the draw or when the move is played.
anonymity.podiumHint: Result at the end of the vote
anonymity.forced: Set by the creator of the Multi game.
